A '''mayor''' was the leader of a [[City/Legends|city's]] government. Cities with known mayors included:

*[[Camp Karnori|Espelar]] - [[Airen]]
*[[Fort Nowhere]] - [[Byron Devo III]]
*[[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] - [[Trey Duna]]
*[[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] - [[Deel Draav]]
*[[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] - [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]]
*[[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] - [[Gramm Rile]]
*[[Theed/Legends|Theed]] - [[Princess of Theed]] (various)
*[[Redhaven]] - [[Tamaktis Breetha]]
*[[Sernpidal City]] - [[Mayor of Sernpidal City]]
*[[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] - [[Acros-Krik]]
*[[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] - [[Kaimer]]

Others:

*[[Kaell 115]]
*[[Kaell 116]]

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], players could run as mayor of their own player made cities, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
